features: High resolution recording up to 1080p AHD, 3MP TVI, 5MP IP
Recording H.264; analog up to 192FPS @ 5MP, 480FPS @ FHD; IP up to 192FPS @ 5MP, 480FPS @ FHD
Internal ODD: 1 DVD-RW; external storage eSATA, NAS (FTP server for backup)
Pentaplex operation: simultaneous live / record / playback / archive / network
notes: Spec sheet states a maximum of 16 analog inputs and a maximum of 16 IP inputs; no combined total is given.
Alarm inputs are stated as 18 (16 plus 1 panic and 1 ARI). Alarm outputs are stated as 8 relay (125VAC, 60VDC) and 8 open-collector outputs.
Power consumption is stated as 21 W max. without HDD.
Spec sheet labels 5.7 kg as gross weight and gives 9 kg with packing materials.
